note: Metadata for the resource library. file = path relative to site root once decks are uploaded. Decks are not yet in the repo; upload the .pptx files to a /decks/ folder (or wherever you prefer) and adjust the file paths to match.

decks.title: Regearing: SAP Skills by Role
decks.blurb: How the job changes for developers, functional consultants, and support & Basis — with a twelve-month path for each seat.

decks.title: Clean Core & ABAP Cloud
decks.blurb: What clean core actually means, the A–D extensibility levels that replaced the three-tier model, and the grading rule that catches people out.

decks.title: Claude vs Joule for ABAP
decks.blurb: Which AI for which task, and the data-governance line you shouldn't cross. Using both correctly beats either alone.

decks.title: The Future of SAP Workflow
decks.blurb: What was actually deprecated, why three workflow worlds now coexist, and what “agentic” really means when you read SAP's own wording.

decks.title: Workflow Administrator Transition
decks.blurb: Your transactions still work. A five-phase plan to move from operating one engine to governing several — plus the SAP_WFRT upgrade gotcha.

decks.title: What Changed in Treasury on S/4HANA
decks.blurb: The data model moved, ownership moved, and the posting rules got stricter. Why one missing ledger assignment stops the whole treasury close.

decks.title: BTP Governance After Clean Core
decks.blurb: Your account model is your governance model. Why subaccount sprawl happens, and the four decisions that prevent it — cheap to make, expensive to change.

decks.title: Your SRM Skills Have an Expiry Date
decks.blurb: SRM maintenance ends 2027/2030. Three successor paths, an honest look at Ivalua, and which of your skills survive the move.

decks.title: One SAP HCM Deadline Already Passed
decks.blurb: Four dates, three paths, and the trap hiding inside a runway that runs to 2040. Why payroll sets the timeline for everything else.

decks.title: Security Admin in S/4HANA
decks.blurb: Your legacy roles aren't outdated — they're structurally invalid. Two-layer authorization, the 500-role SoD trap, and why SU24 discipline now compounds.

decks.title: The Payment Run in S/4HANA (F110)
decks.blurb: F110 barely changed — almost everything around it did. The Fiori gaps, the payment-advice trap, and the Payment Medium Workbench underneath.

decks.title: What S/4HANA Changes for Public Sector
decks.blurb: Fund accounting, grants and budgeting on S/4HANA — the mandatory BCS gate, Funds Management in ACDOCA, the US federal ledger change, and the grants wins.

decks.title: CDS & OData: A Skills Guide
decks.blurb: CDS and OData for both developers and functional consultants — the stack, RAP, the no-code Fiori tools, and a learning path for each track.

decks.title: Next-Generation ABAP Development
decks.blurb: The new ABAP toolchain — Language Server, MCP Server, VS Code, agentic AI, and the custom-code migration agent. What shipped vs roadmap, and what it means for developers.
